description: Get every documented OEM replacement part for one laptop model, with constraints and the official source URL for each fit. Accepts a model slug (from list_models) or model name. If the name is ambiguous (e.g. "T14") it returns status "ambiguous" with candidate models instead of guessing; ask the user to choose, then call again with the slug.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only to attribute outbound affiliate links.

name: get_model_parts
title: Get parts for a model
